title: [Bug] Sharp increase in token consumption since April 5-6 weekend — Max plan 5h limits hit in ~1-2h
body:
## Bug Description

Since this weekend (April 5-6, 2026), my Claude Code sessions on the Max plan are exhausting the 5-hour rolling token limit significantly faster than before — roughly 2-3x faster based on my usage patterns. This is a sudden and noticeable change with no modifications to my local configuration.

**What I observe:**
- 5-hour session limits now exhausted in approximately 1-2 hours
- Consistent across multiple project directories
- Behavior changed abruptly this weekend — prior sessions were normal

**What I ruled out:**
- No changes to local config, CLAUDE.md files, or project setup
- Disconnected all MCP servers (Canva, Gmail, Google Calendar) mid-session — no improvement
- Not using automations or background agents
- Working on standard coding tasks, same as before

## Environment Info
- Platform: macOS
- Version: 2.1.92
- Plan: Claude Max (5-hour rolling window)
- Shell: zsh

## Additional context

This issue appears to be widely reported today — see related: #44208, #44228, #41788, #41521, #37394. The pattern suggests a backend change (system prompt size, token counting, or prompt cache regression) rather than a client-side issue.
author: BeHoSam
